title: Rear setback (R17.5 and above): no provision
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, rear setback: 3m (applicable to R10-R15 only).

replaces.note: R17.5-R25 rear setbacks by Tables 2a/2b have no draft equivalent
Part C applied the wall-height setbacks to all lot boundaries (R30-R60)

verified.note: No rear value for R17.5 and above on p32; Table 4A (p7) prints N/A spanning R17.5 to R60. The page does not say whether the rear setback is nil or the side values apply.

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.1#rear-r17.5. AMBIGUITY (C4P1-087): the draft gives no rear setback for R17.5-R60 (Table 3.4a 'applicable to R10-R15 only'; Table 4A p7 'N/A'), and never says the side values apply to the rear boundary. Encoded as NOT_APPLICABLE through the null row, not as the side values; reads as a nil rear setback unless clarified (register C4P1-003 conflict 3).
